findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.usebridgecore.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: do, make_n8n_workflow, inspect_workflow · Private data: do, make_n8n_workflow · Public sink: do, find_recipe, inspect_workflow · Destructive: inspect_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: do, make_n8n_workflow, inspect_workflow · Private data: do, make_n8n_workflow · Public sink: do, find_recipe, inspect_workflow · Destructive: inspect_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_recipe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
